name: Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta
description:
Increase DMG dealt by your targeted Monster characters by 1. (Cannot stack)
 While this card is in your Hand, whenever your Monster characters use Skills: Grants Cost Reduction to this card.
When this card is Discarded: A random one of your Monster characters gains +1 Max HP.
(Can only be added to your deck if it contains at least 2 Monster characters)
